decision.reason: Static trait-call result inference first recognized a qualified trait path only by its unqualified final name, then scanned same-source impl methods with the same unqualified trait and method spellings and selected the last match. In fixture 1454, other.Comparison.compare replaced contract.Comparison.compare as the inferred method symbol but was declared after the generic Algorithms.less function and had not been lowered yet. The opcode -226 call therefore retained no result type, its comparison binding became Unit, and the stdlib-inclusive build raised S054. The repaired path resolves the call alias to exact module and trait identity and reads the method result from that trait declaration, independent of competing impls and source order. Normalize retained historical verification observations to the existing record contract. Original JSON and terminal outputs remain preserved unchanged. Recorded baseline timeout/cancellation and orphan evidence is retained, not relabeled as current success. No current input compatibility, whole-goal acceptance, new test execution or speed claim.
